raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Starting with delivery batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19), the source began sending amount as a currency-formatted string with a leading '$' (e.g. '$40.14'), so the strict cast to DECIMAL(12,2) fails. Currency is uniformly USD and the numeric part keeps the same dot-decimal format, so stripping the '$' recovers the exact value.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.86, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(trim(CAST(amount AS VARCHAR)), '$', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
